headlines.title: 上半年农产品与食材消费市场规模约4.68万亿元 同比增长2.02%
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月24日讯，今年上半年，我国农产品与食材供应链行业呈现“市场规模温和增长、内部结构深度调整”的运行态势。今年上半年，我国农产品与食材消费市场规模约为4.68万亿元，同比增长2.02%，处于温和增长区间。其中，零售端市场规模约3.55万亿元，增速1.76%，继续占据主导地位；餐饮端市场规模1.13万亿元，增速2.82%，成为拉动农产品与食材消费增长的重要引擎。品类价格分化显著，猪肉持续探底，牛羊肉高位上行，蔬菜水果季节性波动加剧。进出口方面，牛肉、水产品进口大幅增长，猪肉、蔬菜进口持续收缩。

headlines.title_en: First Half Agricultural and Food Consumption Market Size Reached Approximately 4.68 Trillion Yuan, Up 2.02% YoY
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data July 24: In H1 2024, China's agricultural products and food supply chain industry shows 'moderate market growth, deep internal restructuring.' Market size about 4.68 trillion yuan, up 2.02% YoY. Retail market 3.55 trillion yuan, up 1.76%, dominant; catering market 1.13 trillion yuan, up 2.82%, key growth driver. Category price divergence: pork continues decline, beef and lamb high, vegetables and fruits seasonal volatility increases. Imports/exports: beef and aquatic products imports surge, pork and vegetable imports shrink.

headlines.title: Shanghai beats GDP estimates with 5.6% growth – but two-speed recovery persists
headlines.summary:
Shanghai’s economy expanded 5.6 per cent in the first half of the year, beating expectations on strong growth in hi-tech manufacturing and exports, even as weak consumer spending exposed the uneven nature of the recovery.
According to data released by the municipal statistics bureau on Monday, the reading surpassed both the national growth rate of 4.7 per cent for the same period and the city’s own growth rates in recent years, signalling a resilient rebound in the financial and commercial...
headlines.title_zh: 上海GDP增长5.6%超预期，但双速复苏态势延续
headlines.summary_zh:
上海市上半年经济同比增长5.6%，受高科技制造业和出口强劲增长推动，表现优于预期，但消费支出疲软凸显复苏不均衡。
根据市统计局周一发布的数据，该增速超过全国4.7%的增长水平

headlines.title_en: Noon Closing July 24: All Three Major Indices Drop Over 1%, More Than 4,900 Stocks Decline Across Market
headlines.summary_en: 1. Market oscillates and falls in morning, three indexes collectively drop. Defense sector rises against trend, Great Wall Military, Hunan Tianyan both 2-consecutive limit-ups, Jianshe Industry hits limit-up. Power grid equipment concept active, Shunna Electric, Sun Cable, Hanlan Cable 2-consecutive limit-ups. Downside: computing leasing falls, ZhengTong Electronics, Litong Electronics both limit-down; power sector adjusts, Guiguan Electric, Hunan Development down over 8%. Stocks broadly decline, nearly 5000 down in Beijing-Shanghai-Shenzhen, turnover 1.23 trillion by half. Noon close: Shanghai down 1.2%, Shenzhen down 1.77%, ChiNext down 1.78%. 2. Concepts: defense, electronic specialty gas, fluorochemicals rise against trend; precious metals, nonferrous, computing leasing lead losses. 3. 522 stocks up, 32 limit-up; 4638 down, 4 limit-down.

headlines.title: 国务院成立广西南宁横州市六蓝水库“7·6”溃坝灾害调查评估组
headlines.summary: 7月6日，广西南宁横州市六蓝水库发生溃坝，造成重大人员伤亡。根据国家有关法律法规规定，国务院成立调查评估组，由应急管理部牵头，自然资源部、住房城乡建设部、水利部、农业农村部、国家发展改革委、工业和信息化部、公安部、财政部、交通运输部、中国气象局、国家能源局、国家消防救援局和广西壮族自治区人民政府等相关方面参加，对广西南宁横州市六蓝水库“7·6”溃坝灾害进行调查评估。7月24日，国务院广西南宁横州市六蓝水库“7·6”溃坝灾害调查评估组在广西南宁召开第一次全体会议。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: State Council Forms Investigation and Assessment Team for July 6 Liulan Reservoir Dam Failure in Hengzhou, Nanning, Guangxi
headlines.summary_en: On July 6, Liulan Reservoir in Nanning, Guangxi collapsed, causing major casualties. State Council sets up investigation team led by Emergency Management Ministry, involving natural resources, housing, water resources, agriculture, NDRC, industry, public security, finance, transport, weather, energy, fire rescue, and Guangxi government, to probe the '7·6' disaster. On July 24, the team holds first meeting in Nanning. (CCTV)

headlines.title: 网传券商内部发文防范长鑫科技上市炒作，多家券商分支机构人士称未收到类似通知

headlines.title_en: Rumor Circulates that Brokerages Issued Internal Memo to Prevent Speculation in CXMT IPO, Multiple Branch Personnel Deny Receiving Such Notice
headlines.summary_en: Per National Business Daily, a suspected brokerage risk control notice circulates today, targeting upcoming STAR Market listing Changxin Memory Technology, asking branches to prevent new stock speculation. Notice requires warning clients above 500,000 yuan to avoid early-stage speculation; focus on habitual speculators. Reporters verify with multiple brokerages: no such official notice received. Senior investment consultant says never seen such single-stock notice in career. Analysis suggests some brokerages may act individually.

headlines.title: 1H China farm products and food-ingredient consumption ~4.68 trln yuan, +2.02% YoY
headlines.summary: China's farm products and food-ingredient consumption market totaled about 4.68 trillion yuan in 1H, up 2.02% YoY. Retail sales were ~3.55 trillion yuan (+1.76%), remaining dominant; foodservice was ~1.13 trillion yuan (+2.82%), the main growth driver. Price divergence pronounced
headlines.title_zh: 1H中国农产品和食品原料消费约4.68万亿元，同比增2.02%
headlines.summary_zh: 中国农产品及食品配料消费市场规模在2024年上半年约达4.68万亿元，同比增长2.02%。零售销售额约3.55万亿元（+1.76%），仍占主导地位；餐饮服务领域约1.13万亿元（+2.82%），是主要增长动力。价格分化明显。

headlines.title: 国泰海通：市内免税仍处于早期阶段 政策便利化和入境客流修复奠定增长
headlines.summary: 国泰海通发布研报称，当前我国市内免税仍处于门店扩容、消费习惯培育和购物便利化持续推进的早期阶段。现行政策已在销售对象、购物额度及线上预约等方面完成首轮关键优化，后续围绕购物流程、提货效率、品类即提及线上线下衔接等环节仍具深化空间，政策红利有望持续释放。随着品牌及品类供给不断完善、履约链路持续优化，购物渗透率有望从低位稳步抬升并转化为可观的新增销售，进一步放大龙头在品牌、供应链、会员体系及口岸网络等方面的协同价值。

headlines.title_en: Guotai Haitan: Domestic Duty-Free Still in Early Stages, Policy Convenience and Inbound Traffic Recovery Drive Growth
headlines.summary_en: Guotai Haitan says China's duty-free market remains in early stage of store expansion, habit cultivation, and shopping convenience. Current policies have optimized sales targets,额度 and online booking; further room in shopping flow, delivery efficiency, categories, and online-offline connection. Policy dividends may continue. With brand and supply improvements, penetration rate may rise from low base, boosting sales and amplifying synergy in brand, supply chain, membership, and port networks.
